key_findings: IV MSC are analgesic in SNI mice via activation of lung-innervating Npy2r vagal sensory neurons projecting through NTS to vlPAG.
MSC-derived ATP released via PANX1 activates Npy2r neurons through P2rx2/3; ACC is among regions with MSC-induced Fos.
